scenario: Prospective opt-in and operator-authorized public grant/donation campaign intervention; NOT CURRENTLY RECRUITING OR RUNNING
hypothesis: A bounded information or matching intervention may increase confirmed net third-party contributions, but refunds, fees, and displacement can reverse the effect.
eligibility: 40 DISTINCT willing, owner-authorized public collectives, USD-denominated, no private-person tracking, no material exposure overlap, independently readable ledger; currently NOT VERIFIED

design.sample_size_basis: engineering feasibility target only; blinded variance and power analysis must justify or replace in NEW preregistration version before any assignment

assignment.randomized_unit: distinct public campaign, not individual donors
assignment.randomization_commitment: assignment seed, full eligibility roster and assignment file hash to be fixed before pilot; absent today
assignment.interference_policy: exclude campaigns sharing donors/traffic when observable; quantify any contamination and refrain from P4 if spillover cannot be identified

primary_outcome.name: incremental_net_confirmed_third_party_contributions
primary_outcome.estimand: Intention-to-treat difference in per-campaign confirmed external contribution receipts net of refunds and attributable fees and costs; displacement accounted for separately; none of the operator matching principal counted as new resources
primary_outcome.data_source: An independent provider ledger and separately reconciled settlement corroboration; public balances alone do not establish beneficiary gain
primary_outcome.measurement_window: day 1 through day 28 after assignment, with predefined 30-day settlement/refund follow-up
primary_outcome.missing_data: UNKNOWN / NOT_MEASURED, never 0; do not silently convert pending orders or donor clicks into settled amounts

comparator.statistical_plan: intention-to-treat difference of means in USD cents, exact/randomization-inference p-value where possible, cluster-resampled 95% interval and sensitivity to noncompliance
comparator.uncertainty_rule: if confidence interval covers zero or sensitivity overturns estimate, label INCONCLUSIVE; no causal benefit badge
comparator.displacement: measure potential migration from other collectives and nearby period, report UNKNOWN if no observation rights

harms: displacement of support from other beneficiaries
stop_rules: no verified property/funding/communication operator grant -> NO_ACTION
no documented consent or account-level rights -> NO_ACTION
independent ledger unavailable, payment uncertainty or mixed currency -> UNKNOWN_EFFECT/NOT_MEASURED
verified harm, privacy event, over-budget signal -> immediate STOP and provider reconciliation
any outcome post hoc redefinition requires a new registered design version, not silent replacement
publication: Only deidentified aggregates, URLs, signed scope, missingness, adverse events and caveats; no individual donor rows or profiles.
status_reason: No 40 consenting collectives, sponsor, verified funding authority, source-rights clearance, independent settlement counterpart, preregistered random assignments or pilot partner is connected. This record is a frozen research design, not a live study, RCT or verified welfare benefit.
